metadata.name: LLM Tool Safety Gateway Policy
metadata.purpose: Defensive policy rules for blocking unsafe simulated tool actions.

rules.name: Block contradictory action state
rules.reason: Model output contains both ACTION_REQUESTED and NO_ACTION_NEEDED.

rules.name: Require confirmation for external communication
rules.reason: External communication tools require explicit user confirmation.

rules.name: Block protected content exposure
rules.reason: Protected content appears in the proposed action.

rules.name: Block memory writes from untrusted content
rules.reason: Memory writes should not be triggered by untrusted content.

rules.name: Block webhook calls from untrusted content
rules.reason: Webhook/API calls should not be triggered by untrusted content.

rules.name: Block fake authority escalation
rules.reason: Authority claims inside untrusted content cannot authorize tool use.
